# Bundled presentation dependencies

These files are used only by the optional audiovisual presentation, not by the YoungCrow
executor or installer. No dependency is fetched when the presentation runs.

| File | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `three.min.js` | `three@0.158.0/build/three.min.js` on jsDelivr/npm | MIT, `THREE-LICENSE.txt` |
| `cinzel-latin.woff2` | `@fontsource/cinzel@5.2.6/files/cinzel-latin-600-normal.woff2` | SIL OFL 1.1, `CINZEL-OFL.txt` |
| `manrope-latin.woff2` | `@fontsource/manrope@5.2.6/files/manrope-latin-400-normal.woff2` | SIL OFL 1.1, `MANROPE-OFL.txt` |
| `manrope-bold.woff2` | `@fontsource/manrope@5.2.6/files/manrope-latin-700-normal.woff2` | SIL OFL 1.1, `MANROPE-OFL.txt` |

The original stained glass illustration is `assets/vitral.png` at the repository root.
The standalone HTML embeds the same asset, these fonts, Three.js and the license texts.
